candidate_setups.name: Canonical 8B default
candidate_setups.quality_summary: Strongest generic quality-first option in the current repo because it uses meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with a 50-step run and remains the canonical training path.
candidate_setups.cost_note: Highest cost of the compared configs because it uses an 8B model, a 50-step run, and wandb logging.
candidate_setups.beginner_repeatability: Best beginner repeatability for a default because the README quickstart already uses this exact config.

candidate_setups.name: Public instruct smoke lane
candidate_setups.quality_summary: Useful bounded public-model validation lane, but only 3 steps and tiny batch/group settings make it too short for a quality-first default.
candidate_setups.cost_note: Much cheaper than the default because it uses a 4B instruct model, only 3 steps, low worker counts, and no wandb.
candidate_setups.beginner_repeatability: Good for first-run validation because it is cheap and bounded, but it should remain a smoke lane rather than the default.

candidate_setups.name: Quick test lane
candidate_setups.quality_summary: Weakest quality candidate because it drops to a 1B model and keeps only a 10-step debug-oriented run.
candidate_setups.cost_note: Cheapest option of the three because it uses a 1B model and disables wandb.
candidate_setups.beginner_repeatability: Easy to rerun for debugging, but the repo currently treats it more as a test/setup lane than the main operating default.

selection_rationale: Result quality should come first, and configs/default.yaml is the only generic repo-level config here that combines an 8B instruct model with a materially longer 50-step run. Beginner repeatability is still strong because the README quickstart already points to configs/default.yaml directly. The cheaper smoke and quick-test lanes remain useful, but they are better as validation paths than as the default quality-first setup.
excluded_options: The min_* configs were excluded because they are domain-specific workflow lanes rather than the generic repository default.
The non-instruct smoke_qwen variants were excluded because smoke_qwen_instruct_g4_steps3.yaml is the clearer beginner-facing public-model smoke lane among the local smoke configs.
next_step_validation_plan: Run one README-style startup sequence with configs/default.yaml and confirm trainer setup, Atropos registration, and first-step progress.
Run one bounded smoke pass with configs/smoke_qwen_instruct_g4_steps3.yaml to preserve a cheap validation lane and compare operator friction against the default path.
Update configs/usage.md so the quick_test.yaml description matches the file's real values before expanding beginner-facing recommendations.
